title: New Kids on the Block Rock Vegas With “You Got It (The Right Stuff)” Performance at 2026 American Music Awards
summary: Jordan and Jonathan Knight, Joey McIntyre, Donnie Wahlberg and Danny Wood hit the stage at the MGM Grand Garden Arena amid their Las Vegas residency.

title: BTS Sweeps American Music Awards as Sombr Wins Two Televised Trophies
summary: The Queen Latifah-hosted, fan-voted show featured performances from lifetime achievement award recipient Billy Idol, Pussycat Dolls and Busta Rhymes, KATSEYE and New Kids on the Block.

title: Sonny Rollins, Tenor Sax Legend and Colossus of Jazz, Dies at 95
summary: Tutored by Thelonious Monk, the Harlem native came of age with bebop and created a succession of improvisational masterpieces that made him one of history’s most influential musicians.

title: Billy Idol Delivers Empowering Lifetime Achievement Award Acceptance Speech, Closes AMAs With Hit Medley
summary: The '80s rock icon performed "Eyes Without a Face" and "Dancing With Myself."

title: Darius Rucker Honored With Veterans Voice Award, Urges “Every Day” Appreciation for Service Members
summary: "We should be striving to live, to become a community and become a country that we deserve what they sacrificed," the Hootie and the Blowfish frontman said, reflecting on his meaningful interactions with those who've served.

title: Girl Group KATSEYE Deliver Dance-Heavy “Pinky Up” Performance at 2026 AMAs
summary: The six-member outfit, currently performing as five while member Manon is on hiatus, committed to a tea party and teddy bears theme at the Las Vegas ceremony.

title: Hasbro Unveils ‘Peppa Pig’ Kids Bike With Huffy, to Let Little Viewers Learn to Ride
summary: The bike features a bright blue frame with pink seat and handlebars, and Peppa Pig graphics throughout.

title: The Pussycat Dolls Deliver Explosive Medley of “Don’t Cha,” More Hits at 2026 AMAs
summary: The group's three original members Ashley Roberts, Nicole Scherzinger and Kimberly Wyatt were joined by Busta Rhymes at the Vegas ceremony.

title: BTS Greeted by Screaming Fans in AMAs Return After Four Years
summary: The seven-member group kicked off the Las Vegas event with  a pre-taped performance of "Hooligan" from their concert the night before.

title: 2026 American Music Awards Arrivals: Paula Abdul, Ludacris and Hilary Duff Make the Scene in Las Vegas
summary: Host Queen Latifah, Nikki Glaser, KATSEYE, New Kids on the Block, 'Hacks' stars Meg Stalter and Paul W. Downs and Busta Rhymes were also spotted on the blue carpet at the MGM Grand.
